module.title: Persons, Patients and Health Workforce
module.business_purpose: Separates the human person from login accounts and from domain roles. A person may be a patient, practitioner, related person, representative or operator and may have zero, one or multiple authentication accounts over time. Patient and practitioner records therefore remain valid for newborns, emergencies, imported records, external professionals and deceased persons without portal access.
